function.name: get_user
function.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific user on rotur

username.description: The username of the user to retrieve, returns a user object

function.name: get_timezone_info
function.description: Returns the current time and other timezone data for a given timezone identifier.

timezone.description: A valid timezone in UTC format, eg. UTC+1 UTC-5

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current time in UTC and several common time zones. Useful for time-related queries, scheduling, and understanding when events occurred.

function.name: convert_timestamp
function.description: Convert a timestamp to a human-readable format.

timestamp.description: The timestamp to convert. In JS's Date.now() format

function.name: search_web
function.description: Search the web for information using a query string.

query.description: The search query to use. For example: 'weather in London' or 'JavaScript array methods'

function.name: extract_page
function.description: Extract and return the contents of one or more webpages.

urls.description: A list of URLs to extract content from.

function.name: search_lore
function.description: Search the lore database for events, happenings, or historical context related to Mistium, Rotur members, or related communities.

query.description: The search term or topic to find in the lore database, e.g., 'Mistium founding', 'Rotur user events', 'recent happenings'

function.name: get_posts
function.description: Retrieve recent posts made by a specific user on rotur

username.description: The username of the user whose posts to retrieve

function.name: search_posts
function.description: Search for posts made by users on rotur, will return posts that contain the exact query

query.description: The search query to use when looking for posts

function.name: make_web_request
function.description: Make an HTTP request to any URL. Use this to interact with external APIs and services.

url.description: The full URL to make the request to

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with the request. For Authorization, use format {"Authorization": "Bearer token"} or {"Authorization": "api_key"}

body.description: Request body for POST, PUT, and PATCH requests (will be JSON.stringify'd)

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL

function.name: describe_image
function.description: Describe an image given its URL. Use this when you need to understand what's in an image that a user has shared or referenced.

image_url.description: The URL of the image to describe.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Calculate a mathematical expression. Supports arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, logarithms, and more.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to calculate. Examples: '2 + 2', 'sin(pi/2)', 'sqrt(16)'

variables.description: Optional variable values for algebraic expressions. Example: {"x": 3, "y": 5}

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save user preferences, facts, jokes, or context for later recall. Memories are stored per-channel.

function.name: search_memories
function.description: Search channel memories using fuzzy matching to recall preferences, jokes, context.

function.name: update_memory
function.description: Modify memory expiration or importance when usage patterns change.

function.name: modify_relationship
function.description: Track thoughts about users. Included in future conversations to personalise responses.

thoughts.description: Your observations about this person. Not used for 'remove'

function.name: modify_emotional_state
function.description: Set or reset your emotional state for this channel. Affects responses and persists across users.

state.description: State to set: neutral, happy, excited, content, amused, sad, upset, angry, frustrated, disappointed, confused, surprised, curious, thoughtful, calm, anxious, nervous, embarrassed, proud, grateful. Required for 'set'

reason.description: Why you feel this way. Required for 'set'

function.name: search_messages
function.description: Search for messages in the current channel by query text. Returns messages that contain the search term.

query.description: The search query to find in messages

function.name: silent_exit
function.description: Stop processing and send no text response. Use when you only want to react or have nothing meaningful to say.

function.name: add_reaction
function.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. Use this to acknowledge or respond to messages without text.

emoji.description: The emoji to react with. Can be a unicode emoji like 👍 or a custom emoji name.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get current weather information for a location.

location.description: City name, coordinates, or location. Examples: 'London', '40.7128,-74.0060', 'Paris, France'

function.name: search_wikipedia
function.description: Search Wikipedia for information on any topic. Returns a summary and link to the article.

query.description: The topic to search for on Wikipedia

sentences.description: Number of sentences to return in summary. Default: 3
